environment: node test runner, python3 branches.py, cli-runner scratch git repos, no network, no gh or glab

cases.title: Commands line and flag bullet place --branch-format after --commit-format
cases.when: the test reads SKILL.md and runs the documented commands through cli-runner
cases.then: flag after --commit-format and before --max-iterations; bullet between the commit-format and bar-raiser bullets; names {name}, sdlc/{name}, config.json
cases.expected: flag after --commit-format and before --max-iterations; bullet between the commit-format and bar-raiser bullets; names {name}, sdlc/{name}, config.json
cases.actual: all order and wording checks hold

cases.title: Mutated SKILL.md (flag missing, flag before --commit-format) is rejected by the check
cases.when: the test reads SKILL.md and runs the documented commands through cli-runner

cases.title: Branch format bullet sits after Git mode, before STOP removal; old text gone
cases.when: the test reads SKILL.md and runs the documented commands through cli-runner
cases.then: bullet order holds; no Branch name (first run only), branch_name_regex, push_rule; bullet holds all required wording
cases.expected: bullet order holds; no Branch name (first run only), branch_name_regex, push_rule; bullet holds all required wording

cases.title: The preflight and parse commands in the bullet run against branches.py
cases.when: the test reads SKILL.md and runs the documented commands through cli-runner
cases.then: preflight exits 0 with ok, format, derived, samples (a working sample in mr mode), notes, suggestion; parse prints kind slice for sdlc/S-001 and null for main; no tree change
cases.expected: preflight exits 0 with ok, format, derived, samples (a working sample in mr mode), notes, suggestion; parse prints kind slice for sdlc/S-001 and null for main; no tree change
cases.actual: preflight ok true format sdlc/{name}; parse kind slice; main kind null; trees unchanged

cases.title: Preflight with an invalid format reports ok false
cases.when: the test reads SKILL.md and runs the documented commands through cli-runner
cases.then: JSON ok false with an error
cases.expected: JSON ok false with an error
cases.actual: ok false: the branch format 'nofield' must hold exactly one {name} or {name:lower}, found 0

cases.title: The mismatch bullet follows the Branch format bullet and reports both formats
cases.when: the test reads SKILL.md and runs the documented commands through cli-runner
cases.then: bullet directly after Branch format, before STOP removal, with report both, end, a run in progress keeps its names
cases.expected: bullet directly after Branch format, before STOP removal, with report both, end, a run in progress keeps its names

cases.title: A worktree value and a flag value that differ are both readable by the commands
cases.when: the test reads SKILL.md and runs the documented commands through cli-runner
cases.then: preflight returns the flag value team/{name} while config.json holds feature/{name}
cases.expected: preflight returns the flag value team/{name} while config.json holds feature/{name}
cases.actual: values differ and both are readable

seeds.title: cli: no run-time check of the driver's end-the-run paths
seeds.detail: SKILL.md is prose for the driver. The tests check the wording and the commands it names. They cannot run the driver's decision to end on ok false or on a mismatch. The ok false path with a forge rule needs a gh or glab stub.
